plan.notes: Official Plan of Study Grid: Computer Software Development, A.A.S., Kirkwood Community College Credit Catalog 2026-2027 (creditcatalog.kirkwood.edu, accessed 2026-10-02). All term totals and the program total (69) match the published grid exactly (16/15/6/16/16). Term 1 modeling note: the grid's text extraction lists the Approved Math Course row as 'Approved Math Course 3 3' (footnote 3 = MAT-138 College Algebra with Limits recommended, then the credit value); the published Term 1 total forces the math slot to 4 credits (16 = 3 select-one + 3 NET-130 + 3 NET-165 + 3 CIS-207 + 4 math), consistent with the 4-credit Approved Math slots in the sibling CAD program spec. Term 1 select-one: CIS-121 Intro to Programming Logic OR CIS-450 PLTW-Computer Sci Principles OR CSC-142 Computer Science (footnote 1: CIS-450 taken in high school with a minimum C- can substitute for CIS-121; other option is earning a C- in CSC-142); footnote 1 also requires a minimum C- in both CIS-121 and CIS-171. Term 2 select-one: CIS-171 Java OR CSC-142 Computer Science (3 credits). Term 3 (Summer) select-one: SPC-101 Fundamentals of Oral Comm OR ENG-106 Composition II OR SPC-112 Public Speaking OR ENG-108 Comp II: Technical Writing (3 credits). Term 4 select-one: BUS-290 Employ Search/Workpl Success OR WBL-146 Project: Info Solutions (1 credit). Footnote 2 (minimum grade of C- for graduation) applies to the major CIS/CSC courses. The two Technical/Business Elective slots (3 cr each) draw from the program page's published Technical/Business Electives list. The grid publishes no per-course prerequisite list; all prereqs left empty. (The Java I->II->III and .NET I->II->III progressions are evident from the source's own course naming, but Java I (CIS-171) and .NET I (CIS-622) sit inside or ahead of choice slots, so no prereq links are asserted.)
